# Footage App - Private On-Device AI Gallery

> Footage (also known as MemoryCurator) is an Android gallery app that uses local, hardware-accelerated on-device AI to curate memories, score photo quality, detect best takes, and cluster facial identities—without uploading photos to any cloud servers.

## Key Features
- **100% On-Device AI:** Runs LiteRT and ML Kit locally. Zero cloud data transfer.
- **Aesthetic Quality Scoring:** Automatically evaluates compositions, lighting, and focus.
- **Best Take Detection:** Groups photo bursts and filters out closed eyes and motion blurs.
- **Privacy-First Architecture:** Operates completely offline without requiring any user registration.
